lines.zh: 四条腿落下，像四下闷鼓
lines.en: Four legs come down like four muffled drums.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过两格宽的路
lines.en: One stride carries me across a two-block path.
Neck high, I look at the treetops.
I walk in the middle of the herd.

lines.zh: 前面的头领走哪，我就走哪
lines.en: Where the leader goes, I go.
I move slowly without resting.
Grass is pressed into the mud.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面都沉一下
lines.en: The ground sinks with each step.

lines.zh: 湖边的泥很软，我挑硬处
lines.en: The lakeside is soft; I choose firm ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖出一道浅沟
lines.en: My tail drags a shallow furrow.
The young run beside my feet.
Snow-forest trees reach only my waist.
I lower my head to browse the treetops.
My shadow covers a patch of ground.
I chew slowly and take long to swallow.
The herd is all nearby.
I lift my head to listen, then browse again.
Something small moves at my feet.
Standing still, I resemble a tree.
The lake surface throws light.
I will not quarrel over grass.
I mean no harm; I am simply large.
My neck aches; I turn to the other side.
I keep the young safe.
I blink slowly.
Snow falls lightly on my back.
Water sounds far off.
I can doze standing up.
I lower my head and find you very small.
You stand inside my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的脖子太长，低头很慢
lines.en: My neck is long; bending is slow.
You are shorter than my foot.
I do not mean you harm.
Step back; I fear treading on you.
You are looking at my legs.
This range belongs to our herd.
My blink is very slow.
To touch me, you would have to wait.
I raise my head above the treetops.

lines.zh: 你脚下的草是我啃过的
lines.en: The grass at your feet is one I browsed.
I slowly take one step back.
To me that is like an insect bite.
I swing my neck.
The wound is small; I pay it no mind.
I stand still, only breathing.
My hide is thick and stopped most of it.
One spot on my leg hurts.
I would rather not be struck again.

lines.zh: 树叶的味道比什么都好
lines.en: Leaves taste better than anything.

lines.zh: 你举的那点不够我一口
lines.en: That is not one mouthful for me.
I prefer the leaves up high.
Hold the branch a little lower.
I lower my head slowly.
This tastes young and tender.
Back away so I can reach.
I will move on when this branch is done.
The young eat first.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，像撞到柱子
lines.en: You hit my leg as if it were a pillar.
I barely noticed.
I lift my foot and shift it away.
Our weight leaves a pit.
You must stand three blocks clear.
My tail sweeps past you.
Mud turns up under us.
That made me stop one step.
Careful; my feet are large.
The herd stays together.
We follow the leader.
The young stay by me.
I like browsing beside her.
No contest; there is grass enough.
We share one lake.

lines.zh: 她的脖子比我的长一点
lines.en: Her neck is a little longer than mine.
In snow we stand close for warmth.
I guard the herd; the herd guards me.
Slowly, always moving.

lines.zh: 我低下头，用嘴唇碰了碰
lines.en: I lower my head and touch it with my lips.
I push it aside.

lines.zh: 我够不着这么小的东西
lines.en: I cannot reach anything this small.
You take it; I cannot see it.
My foot is right beside it.
I slowly move my foot away.
It has been pressed into the mud.
That weight would flatten it.
I pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 我这条脖子慢，你先退开。
lines.en: My neck is slow — step back first.
My foot is coming up.
I am not attacking you.
Please step behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我能踩到的地方都很危险
lines.en: Everywhere my feet reach is dangerous.
I look down at you, slowly.
Do not run; it startles me.
The herd is watching.

lines.zh: 这件事可以用走的解决
lines.en: This can be solved by walking.
Just stay where you are.
I do not wish to hurt anything.
I shift my weight to the other side.
You move first; I will wait.
I keep watching my feet.
You have moved to my left.

lines.zh: 我的步子很慢，容易躲开
lines.en: My steps are slow and easy to dodge.
Do not stand where my foot will land.
There is room behind the tree.
I go around you on the outside.
The bank is narrow; I slow down.
My tail is still trailing.
I try not to touch you.
One step back and I can pass.
Let us each go our way.
I know this ground well.
There is a wider path further on.
I stop and let you pass.
This is simplest.
My foot comes down.
I swing my neck.
That was an accident.
Only when pressed do I do this.
My tail sweeps across.
You are where my foot lands.
The weight I bring down is great.
That was not aimed.
I step away from your line.
Something small got flattened.
I am no hunter.
I come out of the trees, slowly.
The trees in the snow forest are not tall.
First I look at the lake water.
The herd is across the bank.
My prints are deep.

lines.zh: 光线从树缝落到我背上
lines.en: Light falls through the trees onto my back.
I raise my head to find taller trees.
Nobody here competes for leaves.
I shake the snow off my back.
My shadow moves in first.
Small animals run past my feet.
I walk in slowly.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下沉了一点
lines.en: The ground sinks under me.
I count the herd.
There is water here, and tender leaves.
I intend to stay a while.
The air is cold; I do not mind.
My neck rises slowly.
The lakeside is very quiet.
I take two steps further in.
Flame burns along my spine.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，腿压住了
lines.en: I slid down a slope and landed on my leg.

lines.zh: 水没到我的肩，我站不起来
lines.en: Water reaches my shoulders and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 冲击在我脚下炸开一个坑
lines.en: The blast leaves a crater at my feet.
Something small sticks in my flank.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我骨头里回荡
lines.en: That force echoes in my bones.
Hungry, I can only keep browsing.

lines.zh: 雷击让我四条腿都僵了
lines.en: Lightning stiffens all four legs.
There is no ground here.
